commandList.pointerNote: Lab 2026-11-09, opencode 1.19.5 and 2.2.6 (1.18.32 draws the same, oc--slash-palette): a text that starts with / opens a list of `┃ /command  description ┃` rows in the box's own edge run, right over the bare top edge row, with a closing ┃ of its own; the rows never wrap, a long description is cut. The highlighted entry has no glyph: it stands on the accent fill, every other entry on the box's fill. Enter runs the highlighted entry, so `/comp` with the highlight on /review would run /review (a fresh home screen has no /compact).

probe.note: M56 spec 01 lab, 2026-10-15, opencode 1.18.35: inert after the type and after Backspace in the permission and question dialogs on Herdr, tmux and zellij; the box shows it as `┃  ⌁`; fallback ¤; live sends passed on opencode 1.19.2 only, above the ledger range 1.18.0 to 1.18.33, so the probe stays on until a send passes inside it

paste.blockNote: Lab 2026-11-09, opencode 2.2.6 over herdr 0.9.5 and tmux, and 1.19.5 over tmux: one bracketed paste of the whole text folds to `[Pasted ~N lines]`, N the lines, not the line breaks (one 1,500-character line: ~1; 30 lines: ~30; 600 characters over 4 lines: ~4); 150 characters on one line or 2 short lines land literally (paste.ts, 1.19.0). The same text typed as raw bytes lands literally, and past about 13 rows the box shows only its tail, so a long send typed line by line could never be proven (#749).
